external_resources: https://github.com/chorus-ai — the CHoRUS for Equitable AI GitHub organization, holding 28 repositories including chorus-extract-upload, Chorus_SOP, data_acq_SOP, chorus_waveform, chorus_waveform_resources, chorus-container-apps, CHoRUSReports, privacy_scan_tool and CTP-deid.
external_resources.notes: The organization states that the project is licensed under the MIT License, with individual repositories also carrying Apache-2.0 and MIT labels.

external_resources: https://chorus4ai.org/ — the CHoRUS project website, with pages on the team, project overview, tools, data acquisition, standards, community engagement, ethics, the dataset, and learning resources.
www.bridge2ai.org/chorus — the project website named in the GitHub organization contact section.
https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/10472824 — the NIH RePORTER record for the award supporting the dataset.

https://www.aim-ahead.net/media/jnzdnid3/bridge2ai-for-clinical-care-informational-webinar-cohort-2.pdf — the AIM-AHEAD Bridge2AI for Clinical Care Training Program cohort-2 informational webinar, which describes the dataset snapshot and the access route for trainees.

license_and_use_terms.license_terms: Access to the dataset is controlled and conditioned on a signed licensing agreement: all participants in the AIM-AHEAD Bridge2AI for Clinical Care training program must sign a licensing agreement included in the registration form before gaining access to the dataset, and a ".edu" email address is required for dataset access. The chorus-ai GitHub organization states that its project code is licensed under the MIT License.
license_and_use_terms.source_caveats: The MIT License statement is made about the GitHub software project, not about the data; the source documents do not name a license for the dataset itself, and the access terms described are those of the training program registration route.
